function.name: GenerateVideoDeepfake
function.description: Generates a deepfake video given a source video and a target face.

source_video_path.description: The path to the source video file.

target_face_image_path.description: The path to the target face image file.

output_video_path.description: The path where the output deepfake video will be saved.

function.name: GenerateAudioDeepfake
function.description: Generates a deepfake audio given a source audio and a target voice.

source_audio_path.description: The path to the source audio file.

target_voice_sample_path.description: The path to the target voice sample file.

output_audio_path.description: The path where the output deepfake audio will be saved.

function.name: ManipulateVideoDeepfake
function.description: Manipulates an existing deepfake video, such as changing the target face.

input_video_path.description: The path to the input deepfake video file.

new_target_face_image_path.description: The path to the new target face image file.

output_video_path.description: The path where the output manipulated video will be saved.

function.name: ManipulateAudioDeepfake
function.description: Manipulates an existing deepfake audio, such as changing the target voice.

input_audio_path.description: The path to the input deepfake audio file.

new_target_voice_sample_path.description: The path to the new target voice sample file.

output_audio_path.description: The path where the output manipulated audio will be saved.

function.name: VerifyDeepfake
function.description: Verifies if a given video/audio is a deepfake or not.

media_path.description: The path to the media file to verify.
